sizePolicy.brief: The default layout behavior of the widget

tabletTracking.brief: Whether tablet tracking is enabled for the widget

whatsThis.brief: The widget's What's This help text

width.brief: The width of the widget excluding any window frame

windowFilePath.brief: The file path associated with a widget

windowIconText.brief: The text to be displayed on the icon of a minimized window

windowModality.brief: Which windows are blocked by the modal widget

windowModified.brief: Whether the document shown in the window has unsaved changes

windowOpacity.brief: Level of opacity for the window

x.brief: The x coordinate of the widget relative to its parent including any window frame

y.brief: The y coordinate of the widget relative to its parent and including any window frame
